evidence.reason: DEPENDENCY_RE is the broad [Unit] relationship scan, not a start-only list: it already includes stop/relationship directives such as PartOf, BindsTo, Conflicts, OnFailure, and Triggers. systemd v257 also defines PropagatesStopTo= and StopPropagatedFrom= in [Unit]. Omitting them means a co-installed unit such as backup.service with PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service is not discovered, so the live-binding check can incorrectly report supported=True even though stopping backup.service stops the selected unit. This is an implementation gap in existing intended behavior; the smallest fix is to add both directive names to the alternation.
